verdict.rationale: Expensify's own spend-management docs mention "Smart Limits on cards" and claim the company card lets you "Control spend, automate compliance," which suggests amount-based card limits. Nothing documents how those limits work or whether out-of-policy transactions are blocked when the card is used. Missing for 10: category-level card restrictions, merchant-level card restrictions, documented auto-lock or decline of out-of-policy spend at the point of sale, detail on how Smart Limits are configured, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a finance lead, I can restrict cards by category, merchant, and amount — and the platform auto-locks or declines out-of-policy spend at the point of sale

citations.quote: Control spend, automate compliance, and eliminate reimbursements.
